title: The Bremen Town Musicians

placements.sceneDescription: In a rural German setting, the elderly grey-brown donkey leaves a modest flour mill for the road to Bremen after losing his work. One empty flour sack rests by the mill door; no other animals have joined him yet.
Existing image: the donkey, dog, tabby cat and orange rooster set out together along a woodland path.

At dusk, the same four animals pause at the forest edge and see a warmly lit German cottage with thieves sharing a feast inside. The rooster is high in a tree; the animals remain outside and no confrontation or animal tower is shown.
